verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a named in-product AI layer, Ramp Intelligence and Ramp agents, that takes on finance work: coding expenses, drafting memos, approving when safe and escalating when not, and flagging anomalies. Users can also hand off procurement in natural language ('Describe what vendor you're looking for… Ramp researches options, generates your RFx'; 'Tell Ramp what you need to buy… pre-fills the intake form and kicks off approvals'), ask travel-policy questions in the Ramp app, and get AI reporting. MCP and CLI access serve external assistants rather than a built-in one, so they were not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on a general-purpose conversational assistant inside the product (scope of delegable tasks, how users invoke it), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
